facts.text: Steve is played by Ryan Driller, born Adam Cuculich. He won the 2016 XBIZ Male Performer of the Year award, and Men's Health called him one of the biggest names in the industry.
Director Dean McKendrick shot a near-twin in 2013, Strippers from Another World, reusing stars Krissy Lynn, Erika Jordan, Christie Stevens, Sophia Bella and Ryan Driller in a space-vixen comedy.
Candy actress Erika Jordan was once engaged to Disturbed frontman David Draiman. Fans rumor that the band's songs Torn, Asylum, Crucified and Serpentine are about her and their 2008 breakup.
Pluto lost planet status on Aug. 24, 2006, when the International Astronomical Union voted in Prague. Only about 424 of roughly 10,000 astronomers took part in the vote.
Before his screen career, Ryan Driller (Steve) was a Boy Scouts leader in Key West, a lifeguard and swim instructor, and held a boat captain's license.
Pluto's name was suggested in 1930 by Venetia Burney, an 11-year-old schoolgirl in Oxford, England. She told her grandfather, who passed it up to astronomers at Lowell Observatory.
Director Dean McKendrick followed this movie with another outer-space romp, Lolita from Interstellar Space (2014).
After Pluto's demotion, the American Dialect Society named 'plutoed' its 2006 Word of the Year, meaning to demote or devalue someone or something.
Erika Jordan (Candy) moved to the US at age six, but spent every summer in Germany until she was twelve.
Alan Stern, lead scientist on NASA's New Horizons Pluto mission, protested the 2006 demotion, saying less than 5 percent of astronomers had voted for it.
Ryan Driller (Steve) played the Man of Steel in Superman XXX: A Porn Parody and earned an AVN Best Actor nomination for it.
Erika Jordan (Candy) later turned up uncredited in Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No! (2015) and had a 2015 guest role on HBO's True Detective. She is now training as a marriage and family therapist.
Ryan Driller (Steve) once worked as a radio promotions coordinator, and later appeared as himself on Jeff Ross's comedy show The Burn with Jeff Ross in 2012.
Dean McKendrick's sister film Strippers from Another World runs about 81 minutes and also features Tasha Reign and character actor Ted Newsom (as Professor Finkleman).
Ryan Driller (Steve) uses the stage name Jeremy Bilding when he works in gay films, and Ryan Driller in straight ones.
